uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
969-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

141-3905-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3905-5147.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

710-2843-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

5702-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1839-4551-8089.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2438-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

1619-2921-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7727.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-7009-7704.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-7009-7704.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doc Samson.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

791-2290-7704.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-7704.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6843-7704.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Doc Samson.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

698-2034-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Will.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2085-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1636-2085-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

1874-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-4404-6556.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6556.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Temur Battlecrier.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

573-1993-3259--85--106.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
573-1993-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
573-1993-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-774-3257.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Rakdos Carnarium's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-3257.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

913-2440-4183-7220.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite
913-2440-4183-7220.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

147-2034-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

4050-5078-6089-7028.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Diving Top and then discard any card that isn't Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Repeat.

515-1636-5475.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

339-677-955-2292.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-1669-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

1839-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
1839-4567.description:
Activate Kuro by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

3358-4881-4927.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2523-2869-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3719-4050-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-4050-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping four creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out, adding {1}.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

6316-6527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
6316-6527.description:
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Vela triggers for each creature you control that leaves the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least 7 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2043-6252-6441.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-6252-6441.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3062-3129-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3062-3129-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

277-1170-1645-5921-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-2558-4742-5687.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2178-2511-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-2511-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

575-5256-5971.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
575-5256-5971.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1594-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2590-5256-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2590-5256-5776.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

586-4316-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Gix on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from the top of your library by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

565-974-2871.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
565-974-2871.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Seething Anger from step 2, giving the Smaug token +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control using Seething Anger, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

262-859-1874.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-1874.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Ajani's Welcome four times.
Resolve the first Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

190-202-4591-4701.manaNeeded: {3}{W}{W}{W}{U} plus {1} additional for each opponent you have
190-202-4591-4701.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich.
You cannot lose the game due to having zero or less life thanks to Platinum Angel.
Cast Heliod's Intervention by paying {W}{W}, plus {1} for each opponent you have.
Resolve Heliod's Intervention, destroying each opponent's Lich.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

839-2105-4068-4284-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five modified creatures.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
839-2105-4068-4284-5256.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Combat Celebrant.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Clone and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Clone as it attacks.
Clone triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Clone, causing target player to mill cards equal to Clone's power.
Repeat.

862-1741-2232-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack to put Cloud of Faeries on the battlefield.
Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield ability allowing you to untap 2 lands.
Untap at least a land that can produce {R}.
Cloudstone Curio triggers allowing you to return Crimson Kobolds to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds.
Cloudstone Curio allows you to return Cloud of Faeries to your hand.
Repeat.

364-1283-1309-1987.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
